name: Sarah M.
text: Finally someone mentioned the eyeshadow primer first! I've been using the Urban Decay one for years and it's literally life-changing. My shadows last through my entire 12-hour shifts at the hospital now.

name: Jessica T.
text: Has anyone tried the setting spray method instead of primer? I'm skeptical it would work the same way but curious if it's a budget-friendly option.

name: Marcus L.
text: Great breakdown of the technique, but I have oily lids and even with primer my shadows crease by 3pm. Are there specific primers you'd recommend for super oily skin?

name: Elena K.
text: The tip about setting shadows with a damp brush really does make a difference. I've been doing this for a month and my eyeshadow blending looks way smoother AND it lasts longer.

name: David R.
text: Honestly spending money on a good primer seems unnecessary until you try a quality one. Wish I'd known this before wasting time with cheap drugstore brands that didn't work.
